meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用原始人语气压缩 AI 回复,最高省 65% 输出量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 回复更简短、更省 token
copy.tagline_en: Speak caveman to slash token output by up to 65%.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want terse AI responses and lower token usage.

howto.what: 激活后，Claude改用极简‘穴居人’式短句回复，删去冠词、填充语与客套话，但保留技术术语、数字、代码和错误信息原样；据称可缩减约65%输出token。支持lite、full、ultra及文言文等强度级别。
howto.when: 当你说出“caveman mode”“less tokens”“be brief”等关键词，或要求提高token效率时触发。

say.note: 开启默认full强度的穴居人模式。

howto.what_en: When active, Claude replies ultra-terse like a smart caveman, cutting ~65% output tokens (measured) while keeping full technical accuracy. Drops filler; keeps code/numbers/errors. Intensity levels: lite, full, ultra, wenyan variants.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user says 'caveman mode', 'less tokens', 'be brief', or invokes /caveman; also auto-triggers on token-efficiency requests.

say_en.note: Turns on default full caveman mode.
